name: Norway

income_tax.summary: 22% on general income plus bracket tax (trinnskatt) of 1.7% to 17.8% on personal income, plus national insurance 7.6% for employees (10.8% self-employed). Top marginal rate 47.4% for employees (22 + 17.8 + 7.6).
income_tax.self_employed_notes: Trygdeavgift for self-employed (other business income) is 10.8% in 2026 per Skatteetaten (PwC's page still shows 11% without a year). Employees 7.6%. No contribution on personal income below NOK 99,650 and the contribution is limited to 25% of income above it.
income_tax.local_tax_note: The 22% general-income rate already includes county, municipal and state elements, so no extra municipal surtax. Bracket thresholds are applied to gross personal income; the 22% is levied after the NOK 114,550 allowance and the minimum deduction (46%, max NOK 95,700), which brackets here do not model.

open_questions: Minimum deduction (minstefradrag) not modelled in the brackets; effective tax is a little lower than the model for employees.

Minimum deduction (minstefradrag) is 46% of employment income, maximum NOK 95,700 and minimum NOK 4,000 (PwC); it is not in the brackets or the NOK 114,550 personal allowance, so employee tax is overstated at salaries above about NOK 208,000.

rent_1bed_monthly.description: Average rent of a Norwegian '2-room' flat (one bedroom plus living room) on active contracts, Q2 2026, Hybel / Menon Economics. SSB Rental Market Survey gives NOK 15,260 for Oslo and Bærum.

rent_2bed_monthly.description: Average rent of a Norwegian '3-room' flat (about two bedrooms) on active contracts, Q2 2026, Hybel / Menon Economics. SSB gives NOK 19,030 for Oslo and Bærum.

costs.notes: Active-contract averages understate current asking rents, which can exceed NOK 20,000 for a 2-room flat in central areas.

residence_routes: EU/EEA citizens register their residence and may work. Third-country citizens (including US) need a skilled-worker or similar permit tied to an employer; Norway has no digital nomad visa (not verified on an official page).
open_questions: No nomad visa or expat tax regime found. The standard deduction for foreign workers was abolished from 1 January 2019 (KPMG); the 25% PAYE source-tax scheme is for non-residents on temporary work only.
Residence routes not verified on UDI.
